Product details

SONAR Stainless Steel 2 Liter Electric Kettle
Experience the perfect blend of style, efficiency, and safety with the SONAR 2L Stainless Steel Electric Kettle. Designed for fast-paced lifestyles, its 1500W heating power ensures that your water boils quickly, allowing you to enjoy a hot cup of tea, coffee, or instant noodles in no time. With its generous 2-liter capacity, this kettle is perfect for preparing beverages for family gatherings or multiple servings without needing constant refills.

 

 

One of the standout features of this kettle is its thoughtful safety design. Equipped with automatic shut-off functionality, the kettle stops heating once the water has reached boiling point, giving you peace of mind whether you’re multitasking or simply want to avoid the hassle of watching the kettle..
 In addition, the built-in boil-dry protection ensures that the kettle automatically turns off if there is no water inside, preventing overheating and prolonging the lifespan of the appliance.
he kettle's exterior is made from food-grade stainless steel, providing durability while maintaining a sleek, modern look that complements any kitchen décor. The cordless design, coupled with a comfortable handle, makes pouring effortless and portable, so you can easily move from the kitchen to the dining table.
